name: Skills
title_zh: 给 Agent 装上 AceDataCloud 全家
tagline_zh: 音乐、图像、视频、搜索，一次装齐。Claude Code、Copilot、Gemini CLI 通用。
tagline_en: Music, image, video, search — one install. Works across Claude Code, Copilot, Gemini CLI, no per-tool setup.
desc_en: Agent Skills for AceDataCloud AI services — music, image, video generation, web search, and more. Compatible with Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Gemini CLI, and all agentskills.io-compatible agents.
why_zh: 按 agentskills.io 标准打包，跨平台即插即用。官方维护，接口稳定，比零散第三方技能少踩坑。
why_en: Packaged to agentskills.io spec, plug-and-play across agents. Officially maintained, stable APIs, fewer surprises than scattered.
limit_zh: 仅覆盖 AceDataCloud 自家服务，不接其他云厂商。需要对应服务的 API key 才能跑通；免费额度有限。
limit_en: Only works with AceDataCloud services; needs their API key. Free quota is limited; beyond that, you pay.
